text: MEXICO-EU SUMMIT TOMORROW — A GEOPOLITICAL DECLARATION. EU's Kaja Kallas: When you in Mexico vote at the UN, we vote the same way. Bilateral trade grew 75% in a decade with 13,000 European companies invested.

RUBIO ARRESTS CUBAN OFFICIAL'S SISTER IN FLORIDA — GAESA WITCH HUNT ESCALATES. Marco Rubio revoked green card of Adys Lastres Morera and had ICE arrest her. Empire weaponizing immigration law to punish family members.
MEXICO LOCKS IN FAIR PRICE FOR CORN — 61,000 FARMERS PROTECTED. Mexico signed agreement guaranteeing fair price for white corn after producers losing 1,000 pesos per ton.
Mañanera del Pueblo — 21 de mayo de 2026

🇲🇽🎨 "There is no need for a strike." 140+ meetings with CNTE, significant progress on demands. "We have made very significant progress on their demands." — Mario Delgado, mañanera May 21 SEP has held 140+ meetings with teachers' unions in Chiapas, Oaxaca, Guerrero. Gertrudis Bocanegra scholarship expanding to Chiapas and Campeche — 1,900 pesos bimonthly for student transport.

🇲🇽🏭 "Let's go for Mexico, let's go for corn production." Precio Justo agreement signed. "Nobody was forced to be at this table. Everyone said: let's go for Mexico." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 21 New corn production system: 61,000 producers, 705,000 hectares, 7 million tons. National purchases prioritized before imports. Digital platform linking producers to industry.

🇲🇽🌎 "If the United States wants to help Mexico, it should start by reducing arms trafficking." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 21 Sheinbaum's response when asked about US security cooperation. Mexico has repeatedly pointed to the flow of US-made weapons fueling cartel violence. Said hours before meeting with US Security Secretary Mullin.

🇲🇽🌎 97.5% drop in border encounters — from 305,608 to 7,621. "From December 2023 — the all-time peak — to May 2026, border encounters dropped 97.5%." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 21 CBP data, May 2019–May 2026. Total events: 10.4 million. Current daily average: 283. Presented same day as Mullin meeting.

🚨🇲🇽 "Without Mexican migrants, the US would not be what it is." 38 million people of Mexican descent — 90% legal. "The idea that 'they're all undocumented' is a myth." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 21 US Census data: 38M of Mexican origin in the US, 34M have legal status or are US-born citizens. Presented ahead of meeting with US Security Secretary Mullin on ICE deaths.
